title: The Five Elders' Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: Zhang Shen spread a jade slip covered with names under the candlelight and sneered: "The Sect Competition finals in three days... Chen Ji, I will make you lose clearly and die cleanly."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing looked at him with words unspoken: "Chen Ji, Su Qingyao... is she really just an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow that simple?" Her voice was pressed extremely low, the Demonic Path mist swirling slightly at her fingertips, separating the two in a dark aura.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His gaze fell on the lights of the distant Tianqing Sect Main Peak, those tiny lights like eyes peering through the night. The three characters Su Qingyao stirred a faint ripple in his heart—that woman looked at him always like examining an unopened artifact.

"I'll investigate her matter." Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his tone coldly indifferent as if discussing something trivial. "There's something more urgent at the moment." A subtle smile curled at the corner of his mouth, but there was no warmth in it. "Five Elders Peak is quite lively tonight."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing hesitated slightly, following his gaze toward Five Elders Peak, where faint Spiritual Light flickered, pulsing at irregular intervals like some kind of coded signal. "You're going?" Her brow furrowed. "That's a sect restricted area."

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond. He merely retrieved a black talisman from his sleeve—the Demonic Path mist rune Ye Qing had given him. Pressing it to his chest, his spiritual pressure instantly suppressed to a level barely comparable to an Outer Disciple/Servant, and even the Tianji Record's aura was completely concealed.

Watching his series of movements, Ye Qing suddenly understood. "You knew something would happen tonight." Her tone was not questioning but stating. Chen Ji took his first step, his voice thin and散: "Knowing and seeing are two different matters. Knowing is reading the chess manual, seeing is making the move."

In a side hall halfway up Five Elders Peak, candlelight flickered. Zhang Shen's voice seeped through the window lattice, carrying an irrepressible smugness: "...Thattrash won two consecutive rounds in the Sect Competition, already drawing the Sect Master's attention. If we don't act now, I'm afraid..." He paused, his tone suddenly chilling. "His survival is the greatest threat to us."

Chen Ji crouched beneath the window outside the side hall, the Demonic Path mist wrapping around him so tightly that even his breath was suppressed to barely perceptible levels. Another voice spoke up, low and aged, carrying a subtle metallic timbre: "Elder Zhang, are you certain that小子 has no background whatsoever? This old man would hate to kill the wrong person and provoke someone who shouldn't be provoked."

dialogue.content: A faint smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. He recognized the voice—the Left Emissary of Qinglong Pavilion, a guest official from Xuanwu Sect, an old fox who played both sides among the three major sects. It seemed the forces behind Zhang Shen were even more complex than he had anticipated.

text.content: Zhang Shen's voice rang out again, this time carrying a savage grin: "Rest assured, I've already investigated his background. He's nothing more than an orphan picked up from the wilderness; the Chen family line has long been extinguished. The only noteworthy thing is that he seems to possess an ancient scroll of unknown origin..." Zhang Shen deliberately lowered his voice. "But having that thing on him actually makes it more convenient for us to act."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji eavesdropped on Zhang Shen's entire plan—they intended to cripple his cultivation during the Sect Competition finals under the pretext of "accidental defeat in sparring," then expel him from the sect citing "unsatisfactory assessment." At this moment, he could choose how to act—

choices.text: Continue to lurk and摸清底牌
choices.description: Stay put and continue eavesdropping, ensuring to obtain the names of all participants and every detail of the plan beforecomposed laying out a counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: 掌握全部阴谋细节，获得更多布局筹码
choices.risk_hint: 若对方提前发现踪迹，一切计划付诸东流

text.content: Chen Ji held his breath and concentrated, carving every word from Zhang Shen and the Left Emissary into his mind. In his heart, he rapidly deduced—competitor list, evaluation arrangements, even the names of the disciples Zhang Shen intended to bribe—all were now crystal clear. Enough. These筹码 were sufficient to weave a net that would leave them with no place to die.

choices.description: Deliberately create a disturbance to lure them into pursuit, eliminating Zhang Shen's underlings one by one during the chase, completely isolating the mastermind behind this conspiracy.
choices.visible_cost: 过早暴露实力，可能引发更大警觉
choices.visible_reward: 当场剪除张深羽翼，大涨威风
choices.risk_hint: 张深背后势力未明，贸然出手可能打草惊蛇

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip flicked gently, and a tiny stone broke through the night sky, striking the bronze bell outside the side hall. The bell's ring rang abruptly, and the secret discussion within ceased instantly. A faint smile curved his lips—Good戏, begins.

choices.text: Immediately contact Su Qingyao to form an alliance
choices.description: Find Su Qingyao through the night, hand over the eavesdropped intelligence to her, and use the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's power to trigger this conspiracy from within the sect
choices.visible_cost: Reveal that he possesses leads on Zhang Shen's conspiracy
choices.visible_reward: Gain the formal intervention of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, Zhang Shen's conspiracy exposed ahead of schedule
choices.risk_hint: Whether Su Qingyao will fully trust him remains doubtful, and he will owe her a significant favor

text.content: Chen Ji quietly withdrew from Five Elders Peak, marking several hidden stakes in the night. Within moments, a message reached the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's meditation chamber—'Five Elders Peak, secret meeting, situation changed, come quickly.' He believed Su Qingyao would understand the weight of this information

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji silently memorized everything from this night in his heart. Zhang Shen, the Left Envoy of Qinglong Pavilion, and those hidden masterminds yet to reveal themselves—he catalogued them one by one, like taking inventory. Entry by entry, slowly settling the score

Just as he prepared to withdraw, a voice suddenly sounded in his ear. That voice carried no temperature, no emotion, yet it directly pierced through his spiritual consciousness barrier—'The chess piece has moved, the chessboard of fate is flipping.' It was the voice from the Tianji Record Fragment, the whisper of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's footsteps paused. His expression remained calm beneath the Demonic Path mist's cover, but a faint icy light flickered in the depths of his pupils. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets was watching him again. Every time he used the Tianji Record, he could sense that transcendent gaze注视着他——像猎人看着陷阱中的猎物

text.content: He did not respond to that voice. He had long grown accustomed to coexisting with this feeling of being watched, and each remnant sensation after activating the Tianji Record made him more certain of one thing—the Tianji Record itself is a trap, and he is walking step by step toward some endpoint he cannot yet see clearly within this trap

choice.prompt: Zhang Shen's conspiracy has become clear, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' whisper has made Chen Ji feel a flicker of unease. Facing this crisis that has surfaced, he needs to make a choice between revenge and self-preservation—

choices.text: Secretly cultivate hard to find weaknesses
choices.description: Temporarily suppress this matter, use the remaining time to secretly cultivate, and try to crush the pieces Zhang Shen arranged at the Sect Tournament with absolute strength, making him lose without a word to say
choices.visible_cost: Consume significant time and energy, possibly miss the counterattack window
choices.visible_reward: Crush with strength at the Sect Tournament, Zhang Shen's team collapses on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the Servants' Quarters, taking a broken Elixir from his bosom—the cultivation resource he had accumulated over many days. He sat cross-legged, the faint light of the Tianji Record circulating slowly within his body, transforming the Elixir's power thread by thread into his cultivation foundation. He was gambling, gambling that at the competition ground three days later, he would be stronger than Zhang Shen could imagine

choices.text: Spread rumors to ignite public opinion
choices.description: Elaborately spread the news of Zhang Shen's collusion with external sects, letting sect disciples question Five Elders Peak before the competition, suppressing Zhang Shen's conspiracy with the power of collective voices
choices.visible_cost: Expose that he possesses the intelligence, may face Zhang Shen's early counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Zhang Shen's team's reputation damaged, falling into a passive situation at the Sect Competition
choices.risk_hint: If the news leaks, Zhang Shen may act desperately ahead of schedule

text.content: Chen Ji left carefully designed hints throughout the sect through the night—a note reading 'Five Elders Peak secret meeting at night,' a conversation fragment 'unintentionally' leaked to Outer Disciples. In less than an hour, rumors about Five Elders Peak's collusion with external sects quietly spread in the shadows

choices.text: Turn the scheme against them and set a counter-trap
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee Zhang Shen's specific arrangements at the Sect Tournament, prepare counter measures in advance, and at the critical moment let Zhang Shen's conspiracy rebound upon its maker
choices.visible_cost: Each use of the Tianji Record foresight consumes 5 points of Heavenly Fate, with extremely high risk.
choices.visible_reward: Completely see through Zhang Shen's hidden cards, achieving a perfect counter-kill in the Sect Tournament.
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate value drops too low, it will trigger a fatal backlash with unimaginable consequences.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly unfolded the Tianji Record Fragment, that familiar burning sensation spreading from his fingertips throughout his body. Images of the next three hours flooded into his consciousness like a tide—he saw Zhang Shen's twisted face on the Sect Tournament Arena Platform, saw the talisman hidden in the sleeve of the bought disciple, and witnessed his own wretched state after being struck flying. All hidden cards, laid bare before his eyes.

No matter which path Chen Ji chose, Zhang Shen would never know that his chess game had already been seen through. In the side hall of Five Elders Peak, he was full of ambition and satisfaction, completely unaware that a storm sufficient to cast him into utter ruin was quietly brewing.

The night was as dark as ink, and the lights on Five Elders Peak went out one after another. Chen Ji crouched in the shadows, carving every name, plan, and transaction detail he had overheard that night into his memory. He raised his head, gazing toward the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips.

Zhang Shen, do you think I'm the prey? His voice was so low that only he could hear it, carrying a hint of self-mocking delight. But from the moment you set your sights on me, you became just a piece on the chessboard waiting to be taken. The night wind blew past, lifting and dropping the corner of his robe, like silent mockery.

The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment faintly heated against his chest—that was the signal that the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was still watching. Chen Ji sensed that transcendent gaze but did not look back. He knew that no matter how he struggled, those unseen eyes would always be watching everything above the chessboard—including every trap he had set.
